# undici Advisory Review — 2026-10-27

The full dependency audit (`npm audit`, advisory in `.github/workflows/security.yml`) reported three
advisories against undici 7.30.0, the version `frontend/package.json` pins through `overrides`:

| Advisory | Severity | Summary | Fixed in 7.x |
|---|---|---|---|
| [GHSA-xjj6-f33q-929c](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-xjj6-f33q-929c) | high | Denial of service through an unhandled error on excessive content-encodings | 7.30.1 |
| [GHSA-4qv8-2p9j-2685](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-4qv8-2p9j-2685) | moderate | Denial of service through unbounded memory in the EventSource parser | 7.30.1 |
| [GHSA-f72v-6w45-q472](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-f72v-6w45-q472) | moderate | Subresource Integrity bypass through non-lowercase algorithm tokens | 7.30.1 |

## Where undici runs

Only in the test environment: jsdom uses it to fetch for the unit tests. It is not in the
production dependency graph (`npm audit --omit=dev` was already clean) and the application does not
import it. The override exists so the whole graph resolves one patched undici; it moves from 7.30.0
to 7.30.1, the first 7.x release with all three fixes. 8.x is a major line jsdom does not ask for.

## Verification

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `npm ls undici` | jsdom resolves the overridden 7.30.1 |
| `npm audit` (full graph) | 0 vulnerabilities — the same change moved postcss-selector-parser, used by Tailwind 3, from 6.1.4 to 6.1.5 within Tailwind's range for [GHSA-rj75-hqrm-r3gf](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-rj75-hqrm-r3gf) (moderate, quadratic selector parsing) |
| `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high` | 0 vulnerabilities |
| Frontend suite with coverage thresholds, ESLint, `tsc`, production build | Passed |

Scanner results depend on registry metadata at the time of execution.
